title: Internal and Familial Resources and Motherhood. Follow Up of Mothers With Twins and Preterm Infants Versus Mothers With Single Full Term Infants
brief_summary: To evaluate the contribution of internal and familial resources on the development of motherhood in a population of mothers having preterm twin infants and comparing this population to a population of mothers giving birth to single (or twins) full term infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* preterm infants
* twins

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
